info.title: Papiq API
info.description:
Papiq is a headless document management system; this API is the only way in.

Errors are problem details (RFC 9457, `application/problem+json`).

Authentication: a session cookie from `POST /auth/login` (web UI; changing requests also send
the header `X-CSRF-Token`) or a personal API token as `Authorization: Bearer papiq_…`. Every
endpoint needs one of them (401 without), except health and the sign-in endpoints: `POST
/auth/login` and, below `/auth/oidc`, information, start and callback. A `read` token may only
read (403). The own sign-in (password, sessions, TOTP, API tokens, provider links) and
creating users or resetting their sign-in need a session; a token gets 403 there. Documents
and drawers the caller may not see are "not found" (404), the same as ones that do not exist.

The same services are available to AI clients over MCP (Streamable HTTP, stateless) at
`/api/v1/mcp`, with the same API tokens as bearer; it is not part of this OpenAPI document.
Tools: `search`, `get_document`, `get_text`, `update_metadata` (needs a `read_write` token),
`list_tags`.

post.summary: Sign in with username and password
post.description: Starts a session: the cookie is HTTP-only, `SameSite=Lax` and, in production, `Secure`. With TOTP on, a correct password without `code` (or `recovery_code`) answers 401 with `second_factor_required: true`. A session this browser had ends. Failed attempts are counted per account and per address; too many answer 429 with `Retry-After`.

get.description: The provider sends the browser here. Signs in (new session cookie; a session the browser had ends) or completes a link, then redirects to the path given at the start. If that fails, the browser goes to the web UI instead: `/ui/login?error=<code>` (while linking: `/ui/settings?error=<code>`) with `denied` (the provider did not sign the user in), `failed` (the flow expired or does not match, or no account is linked to this sign-in), `conflict` (the provider's account is linked to another user) or `provider` (the provider cannot be reached or answered wrongly).

get.description: For the user who started it and admins.

Full text and, if the installation has embeddings, meaning in one call. Finds the documents within the caller's reach, the same ones as `GET /documents` lists, with the same filters (they combine; `tag_id` and `lane` may repeat); admins search every document with `all_users` (others: 403). Each hit is checked against the permissions once more before it is returned. The index follows the documents a moment later, so a new document may take a few seconds to turn up. Pages are by `offset`; at most 1000 hits can be reached.

post.summary: Confirm a document from the inbox
post.description: The owner and admins, for yellow and red documents that are not being processed. `drawer_id` must be a drawer the owner may write to (filing checks the owner). Every open field of the steps before `resume_at` (and of `apply_rules` when processing resumes with it) needs a decision: a value or null in `changes`, a value the document already has (it is kept), or its suggestion with `accept_suggestions`. Otherwise 422 lists the open fields in `open_fields`. The rules' fields `drawer`, `title` and `review` always have a value: confirming keeps it, `drawer_id` moves the document. The results before `resume_at` count as confirmed; processing continues from there up to filing, and the rules leave what the owner decided or changed as it is. From `extract_attributes` on, the extracted attributes replace the ones the document has.

get.description: A stream of document events (`document.received`, `document.step_completed`, `document.lane_changed`, `document.filed`, `document.updated`, `document.deleted`), only for documents the caller may read at that moment (`document.deleted`: could read when it was deleted); other users' documents are visible once green. Each event has the event type as `event`, the event id as `id`, and JSON as `data` (see `EventMessage`). Events are thin: fetch the document for its state. There is no replay; after reconnecting, fetch the current state. The stream checks every 30 seconds that its session or token is still valid and ends otherwise.

value.description: None for `present` and `missing`, a list for `in`, otherwise one value: an id, a channel, a text or pattern, a date `YYYY-MM-DD`, or an attribute value as in `attributes` of a document.

case_sensitive.title: Case Sensitive
case_sensitive.description: For `matches` only; other comparisons ignore case.

ConditionSchema.title: ConditionSchema
ConditionSchema.description:
`field` `op` `value`. Operators by field: contact, document_type: `is`, `in`, `present`,
`missing`; tags: `contains` (this tag), `in` (one of), `present` (any), `missing` (none);
channel: `is`, `in`; text: `contains`, `matches` (regular expression); document_date and
number, amount, date attributes: `is`, `gt`, `lt`, `present`, `missing`; text and link
attributes: `is`, `in`, `contains`, `matches`, `present`, `missing`; choice: `is`, `in`,
`present`, `missing`; boolean: `is`, `present`, `missing`.

changes.description: A metadata change as with PATCH; decides the fields it sets.

accept_suggestions.title: Accept Suggestions
accept_suggestions.description: Take the suggestion of every open field that is neither in `changes` nor set on the document.

resume_at.description: `extract_attributes` after correcting the document type, so the attributes of the new type are extracted.

drawer_id.title: Drawer Id
drawer_id.description: Move the document into this drawer (one the owner may write to); decides the rules' open field `drawer`. Default: it stays where it is.

attempt.title: Attempt
attempt.description: 1 for the first try of this event.

outcome.description: `delivered`: answered with 2xx. `retrying`: failed, another attempt follows at `next_attempt_at`. `gave_up`: failed for good. `dropped`: not sent, because the owner may no longer see the document or the webhook is off.

status_code.title: Status Code
status_code.description: The receiver's HTTP status, if it answered.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the attempt failed; the answer body is not kept.

access.description: What the caller may do: read, or read and write.

additionalProperties.description: By data type: text, choice and link: string; number: decimal as string; date: `YYYY-MM-DD`; boolean: true/false; amount: `{amount, currency}`.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: For the owner: the rules the change set off (they hold now and did not before) and what they did. Nothing turns yellow; what could not be applied is listed.

access.description: What the caller may do: read, or read and write.

additionalProperties.description: By data type: text, choice and link: string; number: decimal as string; date: `YYYY-MM-DD`; boolean: true/false; amount: `{amount, currency}`.

DocumentDetails.title: DocumentDetails
DocumentDetails.description: A document's metadata and processing state, with the caller's access.

access.title: Access
access.description: The caller can no longer read the document.

DocumentOutOfReach.title: DocumentOutOfReach
DocumentOutOfReach.description:
After a change by an editor: the owner's rules filed the document where the editor can
no longer read it. The change is stored; nothing else about the document is shown.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Values by attribute id, in the form of `attributes` above; null removes.

DocumentPatch.title: DocumentPatch
DocumentPatch.description: Fields left out stay as they are; null removes a value.

document.description: The document after the change; null if the caller could not read it then.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: For the owner: the rules the change would set off, and what they would do.

visibility.description: Who would see the document; null if the caller could not read it then.

DocumentPreviewOut.title: DocumentPreviewOut
DocumentPreviewOut.description: What a change would do; nothing is stored.

access.description: The caller's access: owner and admins (read_write), or the share.

shares.title: Shares
shares.description: Only for the owner and admins.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: 0 to 1, from checks against the text.

value.title: Value
value.description: The checked value, applied to the document (`ok` only): an id, a list of tag ids, a date, or an attribute value.

suggestion.title: Suggestion
suggestion.description: A value that can be accepted as it is (uncertain fields only).

new_name.title: New Name
new_name.description: A contact or document type that does not exist; an admin can create it.

FieldCheckOut.title: FieldCheckOut
FieldCheckOut.description: A field the model proposed, and its check.

examples.reason: 'Stadtwerke' does not appear in the text

status.title: Status
status.description: `degraded`: only an optional check failed, the API still works (`200`).

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

LinkOut.title: LinkOut
LinkOut.description: A link to an account at the identity provider.

code.title: Code
code.description: TOTP code, if the account has TOTP.

token_scope.description: With an API token: its scope.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Uncertain fields of classification, attribute extraction and the rules (also `drawer`, `title`, `review`), and of filing (`drawer`).

OpenStepOut.title: OpenStepOut
OpenStepOut.description: A step that was uncertain or failed, with the fields left to decide.

revoke_tokens.title: Revoke Tokens
revoke_tokens.description: Also revoke all API tokens. Other sessions end anyway.

status.description: `processing`: `current_step` is due; `review`: stopped before `current_step` until the uncertain fields are confirmed; `completed`; `failed` at `current_step`.

run.title: Run
run.description: Grows with every retry or reprocessing.

RecoveryCodes.title: RecoveryCodes
RecoveryCodes.description: Shown once; each works once instead of a TOTP code.

from_step.description: Discard the results from this step on and process again from there.

unchanged.title: Unchanged
unchanged.description: The rule no longer holds or changes nothing.

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Not changed: conflicts not accepted, no longer writable, ...

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Higher first; the order of the log and of suggestions. Conflicts are never decided by priority.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: `ingest`: when a document arrives; `change`: when a person changes it.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Nested at most 5 deep, at most 50 conditions.

scope.description: `user`: the caller's rule, for their documents. `global` (admins): for every document, but only tags, attributes and reviews.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Higher first; the order of the log and of suggestions. Conflicts are never decided by priority.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: `ingest`: when a document arrives; `change`: when a person changes it.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Nested at most 5 deep, at most 50 conditions.

RuleDefinitionIn.title: RuleDefinitionIn
RuleDefinitionIn.description: The content of a rule; changing it makes a new version.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `overruled`: a person decided the field; `refused`: not allowed (rights, scope, unconfirmed values); `conflict`: rules or values disagree; `skipped`: something it refers to is gone or does not apply; `review`: the rule holds the document for a review.

disabled_reason.title: Disabled Reason
disabled_reason.description: Why the rule was disabled automatically, e.g. a contact it uses was deleted.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Actions that were not applied, and why.

version.title: Version
version.description: Counts from 1; every change of the content adds one.

score.title: Score
score.description: 0 to 1, higher is better; only comparable within one result.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: A piece of the text around the first match, as pieces in order; join `text` for the plain text. Never markup.

items.title: Items
items.description: Best first. A page can hold fewer items than `limit`: hits that the caller may no longer read, or that are gone, are left out.

estimated_total.title: Estimated Total
estimated_total.description: An estimate of the hits, not exact. At most 1000 hits can be reached.

next_offset.title: Next Offset
next_offset.description: Pass as `offset` for the next page; null on the last page.

semantic.title: Semantic
semantic.description: Whether the meaning took part. False without embeddings, with `semantic_ratio=0`, or when the embedding service did not answer in time: the result is by words only then.

csrf_token.title: Csrf Token
csrf_token.description: Send as header `X-CSRF-Token` with every changing request.

SessionOut.title: SessionOut
SessionOut.description: A new session; its token is in the cookie only.

value.title: Value
value.description: By data type: text, choice and link: string; number: decimal as string; date: `YYYY-MM-DD`; boolean: true/false; amount: `{amount, currency}`.

drawer_id.title: Drawer Id
drawer_id.description: A drawer the rule's owner may write to (user rules).

template.title: Template
template.description: Placeholders: `{contact}`, `{document_type}`, `{document_date}` (YYYY-MM-DD), `{filename}` (the original's name without extension); empty when unknown.

match.title: Match
match.description: Whether the words of this piece matched the query.

Step.title: Step
Step.description: Pipeline steps in their fixed order.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: Whether a part of the text was left out.

StepReviewOut.title: StepReviewOut
StepReviewOut.description: The latest run of classification or attribute extraction by the model.

token.title: Token
token.description: The token itself; shown only now.

TotpSetupOut.title: TotpSetupOut
TotpSetupOut.description: Shown once. Confirm with a code to turn TOTP on.

password.title: Password
password.description: Optional; 12 to 256 characters, not the username.

UserOut.title: UserOut
UserOut.description: A user. Others than admins see only `id` and `username`.

active.title: Active
active.description: false ends the user's sessions and blocks their tokens.

drawer_owner_id.title: Drawer Owner Id
drawer_owner_id.description: None unless the document is green.

shares.title: Shares
shares.description: The drawer's shares, if the document is green and the caller owns the drawer or is an admin; otherwise not shown.

VisibilityOut.title: VisibilityOut
VisibilityOut.description:
Who sees the document. Its owner always; while it is green also the drawer's owner and
the users the drawer is shared with.

url.title: Url
url.description: Where Papiq sends the events (POST). `http` or `https`; targets in the own network are fine. Redirects are not followed.

event_types.title: Event Types
event_types.description: Event types: `document.deleted`, `document.filed`, `document.lane_changed`, `document.received`, `document.step_completed`, `document.updated`, or `*` for all, also future ones.

disabled_reason.title: Disabled Reason
disabled_reason.description: `failing`: Papiq switched the webhook off after repeated failed deliveries.

failed_streak.title: Failed Streak
failed_streak.description: Deliveries given up in a row since the last success.

previous_secret_valid_until.title: Previous Secret Valid Until
previous_secret_valid_until.description: After renewing the secret: until then requests carry a second signature made with the old secret.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: The signing secret (`whsec_…`); shown only now. Receivers verify the `webhook-signature` header with it.

disabled_reason.title: Disabled Reason
disabled_reason.description: `failing`: Papiq switched the webhook off after repeated failed deliveries.

failed_streak.title: Failed Streak
failed_streak.description: Deliveries given up in a row since the last success.

previous_secret_valid_until.title: Previous Secret Valid Until
previous_secret_valid_until.description: After renewing the secret: until then requests carry a second signature made with the old secret.

event_types.title: Event Types
event_types.description: Event types: `document.deleted`, `document.filed`, `document.lane_changed`, `document.received`, `document.step_completed`, `document.updated`, or `*` for all, also future ones.

active.title: Active
active.description: Switching on clears the failure count and the reason.

WebhookPatch.title: WebhookPatch
WebhookPatch.description: Fields left out stay as they are.

EventMessage.description:
A domain event, thin: fetch the document for details. Fields beyond `type`, `id`,
`occurred_at` and `document_id` depend on the type.
EventMessage.title: EventMessage

Problem.description: What went wrong. `type` is `about:blank`: `title` and `status` say it all.

existing_document_id.description: For a duplicate: the document that has the same file.
existing_document_id.title: Existing Document Id

open_fields.description: Confirming a document: the fields that need a decision.
open_fields.title: Open Fields

second_factor_required.description: Sign-in: the password was right; send it again with `code` or `recovery_code`.
second_factor_required.title: Second Factor Required

Problem.title: Problem

session.name: __Host-papiq_session
session.description: Session cookie from `POST /auth/login` or the OIDC callback (`papiq_session` when the server runs without `Secure` cookies). Changing requests also need the header `X-CSRF-Token`.

token.description: Personal API token (`papiq_…`); scope `read` allows reading only.
